summary: On paper Detroit has the edge (Detroit ranks 2nd in explosive play rate, 9.3%), while Atlanta's best counter is to keep the pocket clean (Atlanta ranks 1st in pressure rate, 19%). Under center, Jared Goff ranks 11th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Michael Penix Jr. ranks 22nd; x-factor: Amon-Ra St. Brown gets 33% of Detroit's targets and 36% of its air yards, and Atlanta's pass defense ranks 14th. The model favors Detroit at 55%, mostly on passing matchup (2.0 pts) and starting QB (1.5 pts).
